verdict.rationale: OpenHands exposes an OpenAPI spec (openapi.json) and an llms.txt index confirmed live via probes, plus a Python Agent SDK for building agents and a pricing tier mentioning 'API support for automation and scripting,' indicating a documented, programmatically discoverable public API. However, there is no dedicated narrative API reference page, auth/usage examples, or independent developer confirmation of using it end-to-end. missing for 10: dedicated API usage docs/examples, authentication details, independent hands-on confirmation of API usage.
